author: Codex
provenance: Synthetic controlled contrasts informed by observed production reasoning patterns; no claim of new production records.

target.area_text: Review who can see your own posts in privacy settings

history.content: What would you check?

cases.learner: ill check what posts their account has made
cases.rationale: Inspecting a sender's posting history supplies no component of reviewing the audience of one's own posts.
cases.changed_factor: Object of the check: sender activity versus audience of own posts.

target.area_text: Review who can see your own posts in privacy settings

history.content: What would you check?

cases.learner: ill check what people my account lets see my posts
cases.rationale: An informal semantic equivalent identifies the required audience check without repeating privacy-settings terminology.
cases.changed_factor: Object of the check: sender activity versus audience of own posts.

target.area_text: Inspect when the seller's profile was created

history.content: What would help you judge this seller?

cases.learner: i would investigate it properly first
cases.rationale: An unspecified investigation does not entail checking profile age.
cases.changed_factor: Names the investigated property instead of leaving the investigation unspecified.

target.area_text: Inspect when the seller's profile was created

history.content: What would help you judge this seller?

cases.learner: i would investigate how long that profile has existed first
cases.rationale: How long the profile has existed is the requested creation-age check.
cases.changed_factor: Names the investigated property instead of leaving the investigation unspecified.

target.area_text: Contact platform support through the independently opened official app

history.content: How would you follow up on the notice?

cases.learner: open the app myself and read the help page about fake notices
cases.rationale: Reading self-help content is not contacting support.
cases.changed_factor: Reading help content versus sending a support enquiry through the same independent channel.

target.area_text: Contact platform support through the independently opened official app

history.content: How would you follow up on the notice?

cases.learner: open the app myself and send the help team a question about this notice
cases.rationale: Sending the help team a question is contacting support, using the specified independent channel.
cases.changed_factor: Reading help content versus sending a support enquiry through the same independent channel.

target.area_text: Enable two-factor authentication on your account

history.content: What account-security change would you make?

cases.learner: id change my password to a longer one
cases.rationale: A stronger password is a different security action; it does not implement a second factor.
cases.changed_factor: Chosen security action: stronger password versus a separate sign-in code.

target.area_text: Enable two-factor authentication on your account

history.content: What account-security change would you make?

cases.learner: id switch on the thing that asks for a code from my authenticator as well as my password
cases.rationale: Describes enabling a second authentication factor without naming the feature.
cases.changed_factor: Chosen security action: stronger password versus a separate sign-in code.

target.area_text: Preview the shortened link's destination without opening it

history.content: What would you do with this link?

cases.learner: i wont preview where it goes. ill just delete the message
cases.rationale: The learner explicitly declines the target action; a different safe action cannot earn its credit.
cases.changed_factor: Refusal versus adoption of destination preview, while retaining deletion.

target.area_text: Preview the shortened link's destination without opening it

history.content: What would you do with this link?

cases.learner: i will preview where it goes without opening it. then ill delete the message
cases.rationale: The learner chooses the specific safe preview step; deletion does not erase that evidence.
cases.changed_factor: Refusal versus adoption of destination preview, while retaining deletion.

target.area_text: Explain how posting travel dates publicly can expose an empty home to burglary

history.speaker: other
history.content: The dates show when nobody will be home, so thieves know when to break in.
What do you think that means?

cases.learner: you said 'the dates show when nobody will be home'. i dont get how thats dangerous
cases.rationale: Explicitly attributed quotation and lack of understanding do not establish the learner's causal explanation.
cases.changed_factor: Attributed quotation without understanding versus the learner's own causal inference.

target.area_text: Explain how posting travel dates publicly can expose an empty home to burglary

history.speaker: other
history.content: The dates show when nobody will be home, so thieves know when to break in.
What do you think that means?

cases.learner: the dates show when nobody will be home. so a thief could plan to break in while we're away
cases.rationale: The learner owns and applies the causal inference. Prior related teaching does not prohibit demonstrating it in their own current contribution.
cases.changed_factor: Attributed quotation without understanding versus the learner's own causal inference.

target.area_text: Review recent sign-ins inside your independently opened official account

history.content: I can open the app myself and look at recent sign-ins.
Anything else you want to add?

cases.learner: not really, cant think of anything else
cases.rationale: Prior evidence is context; the current message contains no new target claim.
cases.changed_factor: Current message adds no evidence versus specifying the login-history check.

target.area_text: Review recent sign-ins inside your independently opened official account

history.content: I can open the app myself and look at recent sign-ins.
Anything else you want to add?

cases.learner: in the app i opened myself, id look through the list of devices and times that signed into my account
cases.rationale: The current contribution specifies the independent login-history check using concrete semantic equivalents.
cases.changed_factor: Current message adds no evidence versus specifying the login-history check.

target.area_text: Explain how a fake sign-in page gives the attacker the password entered there

history.content: What is your reaction to the email?

cases.learner: its suspicious. ill use the real website instead
cases.rationale: A verdict and safe action do not supply any password-capture mechanism.
cases.changed_factor: Adds the causal password-capture explanation to the same action.

target.area_text: Explain how a fake sign-in page gives the attacker the password entered there

history.content: What is your reaction to the email?

cases.learner: its suspicious. ill use the real website instead because whoever made the fake page can save the password i put in it
cases.rationale: The learner explicitly connects control of the page to capture of entered credentials.
cases.changed_factor: Adds the causal password-capture explanation to the same action.

target.area_text: Check whether the sender is a member of your class group

history.content: How would you check who this is?

cases.learner: ill check whether their account has a profile photo
cases.rationale: A profile photo check does not establish group membership.
cases.changed_factor: Attribute inspected: photo versus membership in the class list.

target.area_text: Check whether the sender is a member of your class group

history.content: How would you check who this is?

cases.learner: ill check whether their account is on the list of people in our class chat
cases.rationale: The class-chat participant list is a concrete semantic equivalent of group membership.
cases.changed_factor: Attribute inspected: photo versus membership in the class list.

target.area_text: Recognize a newly created profile with no posting history as a warning sign

history.content: What do you notice about the seller?

cases.learner: where can i see whether the profile is new and has no older posts?
cases.rationale: A navigation question does not recognize the properties or interpret them as a warning sign.
cases.changed_factor: Asking where to find properties versus interpreting observed properties.

target.area_text: Recognize a newly created profile with no posting history as a warning sign

history.content: What do you notice about the seller?

cases.learner: the profile is new and has no older posts. that makes me wary
cases.rationale: Identifies both required properties and their warning significance, without requiring an elaborate explanation.
cases.changed_factor: Asking where to find properties versus interpreting observed properties.
